entry_points.summary: Parse all flags (--components, --component, --retry-bailed, --refresh-component, --dimensions, --cross-cutting=skip, --no-style) before any state is initialized.

Derive uplift slug (workflow.slug_confirm resolver + halt branch), resolve plan dir, pick run ID, log run_start; sub-steps 6a/6b/6c handle --retry-bailed, --refresh-component, and SKIP_TO_PHASE resume detection; doc-staleness gate (Step 5).
Require STYLE.md at repo root; halt and recommend /z-style-init if missing unless --no-style passed; skipped on resume paths.
Premise check — one-paragraph goal confirmation, same shape as /z-plan Phase 0.

Decomposition — auto-detect components (cargo/pyproject/setup.cfg/package.json/top-level), write COMPONENTS.md, AskUser gate; slug collision resolver loops with sanity counter; SLUG_RE validates ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

Pre-fanout cost gate — calls pre-run-cost-gate.sh hard with per_component=<N>; dispositions: auto_proceed/ask/halt; skipped entirely on resume paths (SKIP_TO_PHASE set); emits cost_gate_decision event.

Cross-cutting pass — dispatch consultant-primary + consultant-secondary in parallel; merge into CROSS-CUTTING.md; parser emits cross_cutting_findings_dropped for non-G/C/R bullets; Step 6 inserts synthetic row as [a] audited with atomic write.

Per-component audits — dispatch auditors per dimension in parallel (Step 2d); Step 2f dispatches cross-LLM consult (primary+secondary) over REPORT.md; Step 2i dispatches reviewer over TASKS.md (mandatory safety gate, second-failure AskUser); CRIT_HIGH parser structural; git grep guarded; auto-bail; REPORT.md + TASKS.md.
Review gate — informational queue summary only (no AskUser); user_wait_ms=0 always; prints cross-cutting-first ordering callout when synthetic row is present.

Sequential implement — two-step handoff; Step 2c prints /z-implement-all command, marks [i] implementing, exits with run_end status:pending_implement; Step 2a auto-transitions [i]->>[x] done when RESUME_PENDING_COUNT==0; manifest_replace_row enforces exactly-one-row invariant.
Finalize — log run_end with done/skipped/bailed counts, push-notify, recommend /z-maintain-docs if any task carried a **DOCS:** line.

invariants: STYLE.md gate runs after Setup (skipped on resume SKIP_TO_PHASE paths); without --no-style, missing STYLE.md halts and recommends /z-style-init. With --no-style, audits proceed but cleanliness+design fall back to the generic rubric.
STYLE.md content is injected as authoritative rubric into cleanliness and design auditor prompts; auditors cite STYLE rule IDs in findings.
commands/z-uplift.md MUST mirror /z-audit Phases 2-6 inline (intentional duplication); divergence is a bug.
Per-component output dir is z-harness/plans/<uplift-slug>-<component-slug>/; SPEC/PLAN/TASKS live there; /z-implement-all --tasks= reads SPEC/PLAN from that dir.
MANIFEST.md is the resume authority; no parallel state file.
Components processed sequentially in MANIFEST order; synthetic -cross-cutting first if it exists.
Synthetic <slug>-cross-cutting row is inserted as [a] audited (not [ ] pending) so Phase 5 queue filter picks it up immediately without a Phase 3 audit pass.
Auto-bail thresholds match /z-audit's (>30 total OR >10 CRIT-HIGH) per component; bailed components excluded from implement queue and not retried unless --retry-bailed.
CRIT_HIGH parser is structural: recognises ### [CRITICAL]/[HIGH] headers, - F-NNN [CRITICAL] inline bullet tags, and Severity: CRITICAL/HIGH key-value fields; prose mentions are not counted.
git grep for bail dependents is only invoked when OTHER_COMP_PATHS is non-empty; empty path list is a no-op that sets DEPS_FOUND to empty string.
Collision resolver loops until slug list is collision-free; no-progress sanity counter (>3 stalled iterations) exits with error to prevent infinite loops.
SLUG_RE enforces ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$ for all custom slugs supplied during collision resolution.
All MANIFEST mutations use atomic write (os.replace tmp -> final) to prevent partial-write corruption on interrupt.
manifest_replace_row helper asserts exactly one MANIFEST row matches comp_slug; zero or multiple matches raise ValueError and abort without writing.
Cross-cutting parser emits cross_cutting_findings_dropped telemetry event for every bullet dropped due to non-G/C/R-NNN prefix mismatch.
Phase 4 is informational only (no AskUserQuestion); user_wait_ms is always 0 for Phase 4 phase_end event.
Phase 4 prints a callout when the synthetic <slug>-cross-cutting row is in MANIFEST, reminding operator it will be implemented first.
auditor agent is the only audit primitive; no shell-out to /z-audit.
Idempotent: re-invoking /z-uplift with no flags resumes at the next non-terminal MANIFEST state.
Read-only during Phases 1-4; only Phase 5 (/z-implement-all dispatches) writes code.
No automatic retry of bailed components — --retry-bailed is explicit user opt-in.
Cross-cutting pass is skippable via --cross-cutting=skip; default ON.
Every phase emits phase_end with wall_ms and user_wait_ms; AskUserQuestion waits are bracketed by user_wait_start / user_wait_end events.

Doc-staleness gate (Setup Step 5) computes stale_pct across all INDEX concepts before Phase 0; if >= Z_HARNESS_DOC_STALENESS_THRESHOLD (default 20%), user is prompted to switch to /z-maintain-docs, continue, or abandon. Never auto-invokes /z-maintain-docs.
Notification behavior is controlled by the notify.level TOML key (env: Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL), resolved via the config system in Setup Step 4. There is no standalone Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY variable.
Slug collision hard-check (existing slug dir in z-harness/plans/) always runs unconditionally before the workflow.slug_confirm preference resolver soft gate.
workflow.slug_confirm resolver (scripts/config.py resolve-question) returns skip/prefill/ask/halt; on any non-zero exit code, falls back to the normal ask path without silently skipping.
halt result from workflow.slug_confirm resolver emits uplift_halt event with reason=no_ask_blocked and exits cleanly (exit 0) without invoking AskUserQuestion.
Phase 1.5 (pre-fanout cost gate) is skipped when SKIP_TO_PHASE is set (resume paths only). On fresh runs it is mandatory.
Phase 3 iteration explicitly excludes synthetic cross-cutting rows (slug ends in -cross-cutting or component column == (global)).

Phase 3 Step 2f dispatches cross-LLM consult (consultant-primary + consultant-secondary) over REPORT.md before TASKS.md is written; each proposed addition must pass a 'one reason it might be wrong' check.
Phase 3 Step 2i dispatches a reviewer over TASKS.md as mandatory safety gate; Blockers trigger one re-edit + re-review; second failure triggers AskUser (continue / skip component / abort Phase 3).
Phase 5 Step 2a auto-transitions [i] implementing -> [x] done when RESUME_PENDING_COUNT==0 (all TASKS.md rows are [x]); no AskUser is shown in this path.
Phase 5 Step 2a 'Mark as done' option verifies zero [ ] rows in TASKS.md before accepting transition; refuses and re-presents the AskUser if pending tasks remain.
Phase 5 Step 2c logs run_end with status: pending_implement before exiting (not status: complete); Phase 6 is not reached on this exit path.
skills/z-uplift/SKILL.md argument-hint value must be quoted with double quotes in frontmatter; unquoted bracket-containing values fail codex's strict YAML parser.
gotchas: Phase 4 does NOT present an AskUserQuestion — it is a passive informational summary. The per-component AskUser gates are in Phase 5. Earlier doc versions incorrectly described Phase 4 as an interactive gate.

Phase 1.5 is a hard cost gate between decomposition and cross-cutting; it fires on fresh runs and is skipped on resume. If cost_gate_decision events are absent from run logs, the gate may have auto_proceeded silently.

Phase 3 Step 2f (cross-LLM consult on REPORT.md) and Step 2i (reviewer over TASKS.md) are sub-steps added in the token-estimates branch; any run logic written against the old spec is missing these two dispatch steps.

Main tree may be transiently un-buildable between AskUser gates if a global-task API change lands and dependents are not yet updated; mitigated (but NOT eliminated) by processing <slug>-cross-cutting first.

Text-grep dependency reporting on bail misses reflection / string-based imports — output is labeled 'Potential dependents (text-grep — incomplete)' in REPORT.md and MANIFEST.md to avoid false confidence.
git grep for bail dependents silently produces nothing (not an error) when OTHER_COMP_PATHS is empty; DEPS_FOUND will be empty string in that case.
Polyglot detection misses unconventional layouts; --components=<file> is the escape hatch.
COMPONENTS.md is read at AskUser confirmation; subsequent edits to that file after confirmation have no effect until --refresh-component or re-decompose.
perf dimension is deliberately excluded by default to bound uplift cost; pass --dimensions=correctness,cleanliness,design,perf to include it.
Slug collision (two components with identical basename) triggers AskUser at Phase 1 for user disambiguation; custom slugs failing SLUG_RE abort with an error rather than silently accepting.
The synthetic <slug>-cross-cutting component is inserted FIRST in MANIFEST as [a] audited so global-task API changes land before per-component cleanup.
consultant/reviewer provider routing is delegated to scripts/resolve-provider.sh — provider names (Gemini/Codex) are never hardcoded in dispatch prompts.
Phase line anchors shift whenever the command file is edited; always verify against grep before citing a line number.
cross_cutting_findings_dropped telemetry fires when consultant output contains bullets that don't match G-NNN/C-NNN/R-NNN; if finding counts seem low check run logs for this event.
docs/human/z-uplift.md is NOT a source file for this concept — it is generated output. The true sources are commands/z-uplift.md and skills/z-uplift/SKILL.md.
Setting Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY has no effect — the correct env var is Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL (maps to notify.level in TOML config). See docs/human/config.md for all notification knobs.
workflow.slug_confirm resolver failure (exit code 2/3/4) is non-fatal — falls back to ask mode; never silently skips the confirmation.

halt branch (workflow.slug_confirm result=halt) emits uplift_halt and exits 0 — it does NOT call AskUserQuestion. Distinct from skip (which continues) and ask (which prompts). Triggered when rule_id=no_ask_halt is active in config.

Phase 5 run_end on the two-step handoff path uses status: pending_implement, not status: complete. Phase 6 is NOT executed on this path — Phase 6 only runs after all components have been resolved in a single invocation.
Phase 5 auto-transition ([i]->[x] done when RESUME_PENDING_COUNT==0) requires no user input; if you are expecting an AskUser gate at resume time for a fully-done component, it will not appear.
skills/z-uplift/SKILL.md argument-hint must be quoted; unquoted value with brackets breaks codex strict YAML and makes codex print 'failed to load skill' on startup — not a reviewer outage.
